name: Click Frames
description: Shows how many frames every click of your run is held for: coloured counter rows in the corner and a circle on each click. Measured live, nothing is recorded or sent anywhere.

enabled.name: Show click frames
enabled.description: Master switch. When off, nothing is counted or drawn.

counter-ranges.name: Counter rows
counter-ranges.description: Rows shown in the corner, as frame numbers or ranges separated by commas, like 1,2,3,7-8,17+.

counter-colors.name: Row colours
counter-colors.description: Colour of each row and its circles. Written as first frame and hex colour, like 1:ff4c54,5:8df791. Rows without their own colour use the closest one below them.

show-markers.name: Click circles
show-markers.description: Draw a coloured circle with the frame count at the place of every click.

last-click.name: Last click readout
last-click.description: Show a small line under the rows with the frame count of the newest click.

hud-x.name: Rows position X
hud-x.description: Horizontal position of the rows as a percentage of the screen width.

hud-y.name: Rows position Y
hud-y.description: Vertical position of the rows as a percentage of the screen height.

marker-text-scale.name: Circle text scale
marker-text-scale.description: Size of the frame number inside the click circles.

marker-fade.name: Circles disappear after
marker-fade.description: Seconds before a click circle fades out. 0 keeps the circles until you restart the level.
